claims.text: The Random Kitchen Sink (RKS) approach is used to map embedding vectors to a dimension where the data becomes linearly separable.
RKS provides an approximate kernel function via explicit mapping, which enhances the performance of machine learning algorithms.
The RKS approach has shown effectiveness in offensive language detection and other NLP tasks.
